findings.location: Proof, step 5.1: “the flux of the C1 field curl F”; the Statement assumes only F is C1.
findings.evidence: For F(x,y,z)=(0,0,|x|^(3/2)), F is C1 but curl F=(0,-(3/2)sgn(x)sqrt(|x|),0) is not differentiable at x=0. The cited flux definition requires only continuity. Replace the intermediate regularity assertion with continuous, preserving the theorem's stated hypotheses.
